title: Prism 8
tagline: An AI agent that tokenizes real estate and streams rent to investors, second by second
description:
Project Description
Prism 8 is an autonomous Real-Estate Tokenization and Continuous Yield Streaming Engine. It enables autonomous AI agents to verify real-world properties, tokenize fractional shares, and stream rental income directly to investor wallets per-second—all secured by ERC-7579 modular session keys and Hedera x402 machine micropayments.

Zero Custody Risk : Grant AI agents scoped execution authority via EIP-712 session keys with hard-coded spend caps, action whitelists, and 24-hour expirations.
Continuous Cashflow : Eliminate 30-day payout cycles with Superfluid CFA streaming rental yield into investor wallets every single second (+$0.000146/sec).
Machine-to-Machine Payments : Autonomous agents settle on-demand oracle paywalls on Hedera testnet using the x402 protocol with no subscriptions or human intervention.
Self-Mutating Indexing : Dual Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers allow LLMs to query live shareholder distributions and autonomously redeploy subgraphs on The Graph Studio.

🌟 What Makes Prism 8 Revolutionary:

Instant tokenization : Turn physical properties into liquid on-chain shares in minutes
Automated payouts : Rent auto-distributes to all shareholders with zero paperwork
Physical verification : USPS oracle verifies real addresses before any token minting
Zero admin hassle : AI handles cap tables, paywalls, and compliance automatically
For Investors:

Per-second streaming : Get rental yield paid every second instead of waiting 30 days
Micro-investing : Own real estate fractions starting with just a few dollars
100% transparency : See live cap tables and payouts on-chain via The Graph
Zero custody risk : AI agents operate under your pre-set budget caps, never your private key

ERC-7579 Session Keys — Delegate safe spending allowances to AI agents
Per-Second Yield Streams — Continuous Superfluid cashflow ticking in real-time
Hedera x402 Micropayments — Machine-to-machine oracle payments with sub-cent fees
The Graph AI Tooling — Dual MCP servers for natural language data queries and indexing
On-Chain Guardrails — Malicious or out-of-policy actions get stopped instantly
Tenant Rent Simulator — Test rent inflows and watch live cashflows speed up
